images.caption: CAMP BLANDING JOINT TRAINING CENTER, Fla. (Feb. 09, 2013) – Special Forces Soldiers of the Florida National Guard’s 3rd Battalion, 20th Special Forces Group (Airborne) stand in formation behind their battalion guidon during a 50th Anniversary ceremony at Camp Blanding Joint Training Center, Fla., Feb. 9, 2013.  The event marked the 50th Anniversary of the establishment of the unit on February 15, 1963.  Special Forces Soldiers, also known as Green Berets, are experts trained in unconventional warfare, direct action, special reconnaissance, and other special activities.  Photo by Spc. N. Bobby Ballard, 107th Mobile Public Affairs Detachment

Titshaw Jr., The Adjutant General of Florida, affixes a campaign streamer to the unit guidon of the 3rd Battalion, 20th Special Forces Group for their actions in support of Operation Enduring Freedom. images.caption: U.S. Marines and Sailors aboard a small unit riverine craft walk on to a beach during Unitas-Partnership of the Americas 2012 Sept. 8, 2012, at Camp Blanding, Fla. Unitas, Latin for "unity," is an annual U.S. Southern Command-sponsored, multinational naval exercise designed to enhance security cooperation and improve coalition operations between South American and U.S. maritime forces. Partnership of the Americas is an annual combined exercise directed by U.S. Southern Command that is designed to improve training and readiness of U.S. naval forces in the region and enhance interoperability and relationships with other countries’ civil and military forces. (DoD photo by Cpl. Tyler Thornhill, U.S. Marine Corps/Released)

images.caption: U.S. and Ecuadorian Marines provide security on a corner while conducting danger-crossing area training during UNITAS-Partnership of the Americas 2012 at Camp Blanding Joint Training Center, Fla., Sept. 5, 2012. UNITAS-Partnership of the Americas gives the participating multinational troops from Brazil, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Mexico, Paraguay, Peru, and Uruguay an opportunity to exercise critical thinking based on realistic scenarios, reinforce essential tactics and techniques and build on a strong foundation of professional cooperation. (DoD photo by Cpl. Tyler Thornhill, U.S Marine Corps/Released)
